# DK Coaching

> DK Coaching is the practice of Devika Kapoor, a Life Design Coach and Human Development Consultant based in Manchester, United Kingdom. Everything is built on one idea: living by design, not by default. Individuals come for life design coaching; organisations come for staff development programmes and employee coaching; rental living operators come for resident development.

## Services

- [Self by Design](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/self-by-design): one-to-one life design coaching for people in transition. Flagship 3-month programme.
- [Work by Design](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/work-by-design): staff development programmes, employee coaching, workplace workshops and speaking for organisations and teams. Trusted by organisations including the NHS, Reckitt, Merseyrail, the King's Trust and the Royal College of Physicians.
- [Live by Design](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/live-by-design): resident development programmes for Build to Rent and coliving operators, measured through to renewal.
- [Clarity Intensive](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/clarity-intensive): a single deep-dive coaching session, 90 minutes.
- [The Pivot Pack](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/pivot-pack): three sessions for people navigating a career change.

## Method

Every engagement follows three steps: Understand, Reframe, Design. The signature framework is the Personal Operating System, which makes how a person actually operates visible so it can be redesigned deliberately.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog): essays on life design, career change and development as infrastructure.
- [Career Change at 30](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog/career-change-at-30): why it is not too late and how to do it properly.
- [Work by Design: development is infrastructure](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog/work-by-design-development-is-infrastructure): why the organisations that win the next five years treat development as infrastructure, not a perk.
